chose: The combined cache-warning gauge (call_render_cache_warning_timestamp_seconds: the newest warning across the six render jobs' status folders, which CallRenderCacheFull reads) keeps a time read beside an unreadable job folder as a lower bound, and is NaN only when no folder reads a warning time. Each unreadable folder still counts in call-weeks/observe, so HomeFailuresOpen tells it.
options: Keep a time read beside an unreadable folder as a lower bound; NaN only when no folder reads a warning time; each unreadable folder held open in call-weeks/observe
Any unreadable folder makes the combined gauge NaN, silencing a known-recent warning CallRenderCacheFull used to fire on, until HomeFailuresOpen speaks after about 2 hours
Skip unreadable folders silently and show the newest read, with no open level (an erasure)
gray: The owner's choice on server#1207, 'a failed reading empties the gauge', is kept where a reading has its own gauge: an unreadable job folder is never 0 or its last value, and is held open. The combined gauge has no per-folder value, though, so under this call one unreadable folder empties no gauge while another folder holds a warning time that read; it is told only by call-weeks/observe and HomeFailuresOpen, which is close to the option the owner did not choose for that case. #1207's hand-off (the coordinator's, item 5) asked for Unreadable to win through Disk::and, and this call reverses that. The reason: 'a warning in the last day' stays true of a time that was read, whatever another folder holds, the same lower-bound reading as C1511's deploy totals. The owner may read #1207 as covering the combined gauge too.
undo: In Reading::newest, put (Self::Unreadable, _) | (_, Self::Unreadable) => Self::Unreadable first again and narrow the second arm back to (Self::Read(at), Self::Absent) | (Self::Absent, Self::Read(at)); restore the test in metrics/call_weeks.rs to its old name, the_newest_of_two_readings_is_unknown_when_either_is, with Read(1).newest(unreadable) == unreadable, dropping the two asserts 0546e17 added; and put back the CallWeeksObserve and observe_renders doc wording that server#1207's PR narrowed for this call (an unread signal's gauges are NaN). The per-folder count in observe_renders can stay.
